event_summary: A yellow ball with black face markings remains on a black circular platform while its visible markings rotate out of front view.
raw_event_description: At the start, a yellow ball with a drawn smiley face is visible on top of a black circular platform on a wooden tabletop, with the same setup reflected in a mirror at the right. Over the clip, the ball stays in approximately the same position on the platform while the black markings on the ball progressively shift from a front-facing smiley face to a side-facing position and then mostly out of view. The mirror reflection shows the corresponding changing view of the ball. The tabletop, mirror, wall, cable, and dark vertical object at the right remain visually fixed.

reasons: The yellow ball, black circular platform, tabletop, mirror, cable, and wall are clearly visible.
The ball is already positioned on the platform at the first frame.
No separate pre-event interval is visible before the ball's markings begin changing orientation.
